title: Add-On Terms for VPS and Dedicated Servers
content:
**A1. When add-ons may change.** Add-ons may be changed only while the server status is active. An add-on change on a server in the VPS and Dedicated Servers range covers its extra IPv4 addresses, backups, managed support, control panel licence or auto-renew setting.

**A2. Prices.** Extra IPv4 addresses cost the tier's price per extra address per month each, up to the tier's most extra addresses allowed. Backups cost the tier's backup percentage of the server's monthly price where the backup add-on can be added on that tier. Managed support costs the tier's managed support price per month where managed support can be added on that tier, and the control panel licence costs the tier's control panel licence price per month.

**A3. Managed support and the control panel licence.** Managed support may be added only to a server that also has the control panel licence, as managed support requires a supported control panel licence on the server, and removing the licence removes managed support with it.

**A4. Mid-term changes.** An add-on added mid-term is billed prorated by calendar days to the term end, and an add-on removed mid-term is not refunded and simply stops at the next renewal.

**A5. Snapshots and reinstalls.** Snapshots beyond the tier's free snapshot slots are billed at the tier's snapshot price per GB-month, and an operating system reinstall costs the tier's reinstall fee.

## Server status and add-on changes

| Server status on the holding record | Add-ons may be changed |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes |
| Provisioning, suspended, cancel pending, cancelled or terminated | No |

## Managed support and the licence together

| Control panel licence on the server | Request | Result under A3 |
|---|---|---|
| Present | Add managed support, on a tier where it can be added | May be added |
| Absent | Add managed support | May not be added while the licence is absent |
| Present, with managed support | Remove the licence | Managed support is removed with it |

## Billing effects

- An add-on added mid-term is billed on its own line, by kind: extra IPv4, backups, managed support or control panel. The line covers the period from its first day to the term end.
- An add-on removed mid-term produces no refund line; it stays on the server until the next renewal and is not renewed.
- The count of extra IPv4 addresses on a server is at most the tier's most extra addresses allowed.
